meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对随时间变化的数据做预测、分类与异常检测
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一批随时间记录的数据要建模分析
copy.tagline_en: Forecast, classify, and detect anomalies in data that changes over time
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have time-stamped data that needs modeling and analysis

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 aeon 这个 Python 库处理时间序列数据:做分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割等,并给出可运行的 scikit-learn 风格代码。
howto.when: 当你处理时间序列或按时间索引的数据,需要分类、预测、异常检测等专门算法,而不是普通机器学习方法时,它会接管。

say.text: 用 DTW 距离把这些序列聚成 3 类,输出每条序列的簇标签
say.note: 会返回聚类标签和簇中心

say.text: 用 STOMP 检测这段序列里的异常点,并画出异常分数曲线
say.note: 会返回异常分数并画图

howto.what_en: With aeon installed, Claude handles time series machine learning in Python — classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation and more — returning runnable scikit-learn-style code.
howto.when_en: Use it when you work with temporal or time-indexed data and need specialized algorithms for tasks such as classification, forecasting, or anomaly detection.

say_en.text: Use aeon's RocketClassifier to classify this time series dataset and give me the code.
say_en.note: Trains a ROCKET classifier and reports accuracy.

say_en.text: Cluster these series into 3 groups with DTW distance and output the cluster labels.
Detect anomalies in this series with aeon's STOMP and plot the anomaly scores.
